cohort: 30 pregnant women with singleton live intrauterine gestations over 24 weeks with oligohydramnios (AFI <5 cm or borderline AFI 5-8 cm) referred for routine antenatal checkup or clinical suspicion of oligohydramnios in the third trimester, excluding those with fetal anomalies, premature rupture of membrane, diabetes, hypertension, or Rh incompatibility.
finding: Uterine, umbilical, and fetal MCA Doppler velocimetry are associated with increased incidence of adverse outcomes in both severe and borderline third-trimester oligohydramnios, with abnormal Doppler studies of all three vessels showing the highest incidence of IUGR and NICU admission.
birth_weight: recorded as outcome measure, but no specific range given
